Nadia (People Ops): Quick ping : visitor drop at 11:20    Hi all, we have a surprise delivery for a 'conference pack' with no recipient name. Courier left it at the desk and there's a sticky 'for onboarding' 
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x conference pack, no recipient. Placed in holding locker #8. No badge preprint.
Omar: Could be for the new hire orientation? Im running the session at 11:30. Can someone check the HR calendar for attendees?
Bea: I'm in HR  I'll check. If it's for orientation, please move to the training room before 11:25.
Front Desk (Bot): HR confirmed 11:30 onboarding in Training Room 2 (12 people). Temp badge pack usually included in conference pack.
Nadia (People Ops): Bea, can you confirm if we need to hand out name-tag lanyards? If so I'll grab them.
Bea: Yes please we need 12 lanyards + privacy forms. If the pack has them, just move the sealed box to Training Room 2.
Omar: I'll meet at the lobby at 11:20 to escort and help set up the table.
Front Desk (Bot): Package transferred to Training Room 2 at 11:22. Lanyards confirmed inside (12). Escort assigned: Omar.
Nadia (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Note to team: if a package has no recipient but matches scheduled event, we default to event organizer. Leaving a log entry.
Bea: Package unpacked and items placed on table. All set for 11:30.
Nadia (People Ops): Closing thread  :white_check_mark:
